# proxmox_node_spiceshell (Data Source)

Requests a node SPICE shell proxy from `/nodes/{node}/spiceshell`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_spiceshell" "s" {
  node  = "pve-1"
  proxy = "https://pve-1:8006"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `proxy` (String)

### Optional

- `command` (String)
- `command_opts` (String)

### Read-Only

- `port` (String)
- `result` (String)
- `ticket` (String, Sensitive)
- `upid` (String)
- `user` (String)
